title: Tricuspid regurgitation and additional cardiac amyloidosis: early diagnosis and treatment to prevent disease progression
summary: Patients with cardiac amyloidosis (CA) frequently present with valvular heart disease, including tricuspid regurgitation (TR). Conversely, the prevalence of CA among patients with TR is likely also increased. Both conditions are associated with reduced life expectancy, and early diagnosis is often hampered by their very similar symptoms, which can also delay the initiation of therapy. This study investigates the prevalence, prognosis, diagnosis, and treatment of these two coexisting conditions.

interventions.name: Patients with and without cardiac amyloidosis (CA) and tricuspid regurgitation (TR)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with cardiac amyloidosis (CA) 
Patients with tricuspid regurgitation (TR)
First presentation between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2025
Exclusion criteria:
None
